tool_input.command:
python3 -m ledger.cli report --group-by month fixtures/transactions.csv | head -4
echo "--- json (month, first line) ---"
python3 -m ledger.cli report --group-by month --format json fixtures/transactions.csv | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(list(d)[:3], d['2025-01'], sum(d.values()))"
echo "--- group-by account text ---"
python3 -m ledger.cli report --group-by account fixtures/transactions.csv
echo "--- summary total for comparison + completeness check ---"
python3 -m ledger.cli report --format json fixtures/transactions.csv | python3 -c "import json,sys; print('total', json.load(sys.stdin)['total'])"
python3 -m ledger.cli report --group-by category --format json fixtures/transactions.csv | python3 -c "
import json,sys
from decimal import Decimal
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print('category groups', len(d), 'sum', sum(Decimal(str(v)) for v in d.values()))"
echo "--- absent option unchanged, filters combine, bad choice ---"
python3 -m ledger.cli report --group-by month --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-02-28 fixtures/transactions.csv
python3 -m ledger.cli report --group-by payee fixtures/transactions.csv; echo "exit=$?"
tool_input.description: Exercise the new option against the fixture
